link.title: Essentials
link.description: The addons every pipeline bundle starts from. Core is declared as required by 53 other addons and Applications by 8. Core's code also needs 3rd party binaries (FFmpeg and OpenImageIO) and OCIO configs (the built-in color configs), although it lists them only as compatible addons. TrayPublisher completes the base publishing features and is required by Batch Ingest.
